patterns.note: Asymmetrical two-column layouts are frequently used, pairing large text blocks with illustrative images or UI mockups, often with the image side slightly elevated or offset.
Strategic use of a vibrant accent green (#137345) to highlight key product names (e.g., 'WhatsApp') within dark green (#003642) headings, creating strong brand association.
Sections reveal with a subtle fade-in and slight upward slide animation as they enter the viewport, creating a dynamic content flow.
Feature sections often use a grid of cards with a light background, each containing an icon, title, and short description, contrasting with darker full-width sections.
Headings frequently use a large, bold sans-serif font, with specific keywords emphasized by a contrasting color to draw attention to core concepts.

technique_notes: Sections are revealed using scroll-triggered CSS keyframe animations that apply a subtle fade-in and translate-up effect as they become visible.
The primary navigation bar remains fixed at the top of the viewport during scroll, maintaining accessibility to site links without visual transformation.
Key product names or features within large headings are visually emphasized by applying a contrasting brand accent color to specific words.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, bold sans-serif headings (up to ~3-4x body size) with a clear hierarchy, complemented by readable body text and smaller, often uppercase labels.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounding on buttons and some card elements, but mostly sharp corners for overall layout and section boundaries.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced, with airy hero and generous section padding, while content within feature cards maintains a moderate density.

standout: The site's distinctive use of a deep, rich dark green as a primary background, paired with a vibrant accent green to highlight key product names like 'WhatsApp' in large headings, creates a strong, memorable brand identity. The integration of realistic UI mockups directly into asymmetrical layouts also effectively showcases the product's functionality.
